items.headline: Viliami Teu runs for 2 TDs, San Jose State beats winless Northern Illinois 30-19
items.description: — Viliami Teu ran for two touchdowns and San Jose State got closer to bowl eligibility with a 30-19 victory over winless Northern Illinois on Saturday.

items.headline: Humphrey scores 2 TDs and New Mexico beats San Jose State to remain unbeaten in Mountain West games
items.description: — Scottre Humphrey rushed for two touchdowns and New Mexico beat San Jose State 21-16 on Saturday to win its fifth straight game and remain unbeaten in Mountain West Conference games.
